backdrop.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: opaque side-scrolling driving-game panorama. Input 1 is the SEASONAL EDIT TARGET: preserve its biome, seasonal identity, broad tree placement and very wide composition. Input 2 is the APPROVED STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its bold chunky tree shapes, rich saturated natural colours, confident visible brush strokes, readable silhouettes and crafted detailed storybook game illustration finish. Hand-painted, slightly stylised, soft diffuse light from ABOVE, no strong diagonal sunbeams. Layered forest depth with softly simplified distant trees and a blue sky with chalky-white painted clouds. Trees frame the sides and leave an open central view across the marsh. Keep the lower third a calm uninterrupted single-colour band for the game road; place all scenery above 66.5 percent image height. No foreground road, people, vehicles, structures, UI, text, logos, watermark or border. Full-bleed opaque landscape. Output EXACTLY 2172 x 724 pixels, 3:1 panorama; do not crop or zoom. Spring thaw: fresh lime and rich green new leaves on broad moss-draped trees, melting chalky-white snowbanks, grey-blue slush and calm meltwater among soft reeds. Rust-orange accents subtly in exposed bark and old reeds, but new foliage stays spring green. Preserve small remaining snow patches, not full winter snow cover. Soft cool layered distance with a lively welcoming spring feeling. The lower calm band is subdued sage green matching the target. Bold confident brushwork and chunky leaf shapes.
